The probe's combat declines the may, so no creature is tapped. Pack tap_pump: the may taps Bear and Giant (yours), not Opp Bear or the artifact (pass). The filter is CONTROLLER_IS YOU + IS_UNTAPPED + TYPE_EQ Creature, the same as the compiler's B2b-siege-striker template
clauses.issue: 'any number' is QUnbounded CHOOSE, which the executor resolves as every candidate, so the choice is all-or-none (fire/skip) rather than any subset. That removes options and is never stronger than printed.
